description.value: Spirit Rock Climbing Center is a three-story indoor climbing gym in the heart of Kimberley's Platzl, open since 2013. It offers bouldering, auto-belays, top-rope and lead climbing on walls ranging from 8 to 50 feet, welcoming all ages and abilities with no experience or booking required. The facility also has a retail shop for climbing gear and runs youth and adult programs.
